$comment: Records the commit of each independently-versioned subproject that together form a working set. The three app repos have their own remotes and are NOT tracked by this repository; liveKit-video-infra IS tracked here. Verify with `npm run pin:check`, restore with `npm run pin:sync`, re-pin with `npm run pin:update`.
note: READMEs rewritten to describe the real platform scope across all four projects. Follows the Patvero user-facing copy rename; the Mohuddle identity provider integration remains unchanged.

liveKit-be.subject: Seal completed documents: burn signatures into the PDF with a certificate

liveKit-video-fe.subject: Rebuild the signing ceremony: sign directly on the document

liveKit-video-mobile.subject: Sync API contracts for the portal history and consent endpoints
